name: 2001 Mars Odyssey
objective: Map elements and minerals and relay communications for surface missions

name: Apollo 11
objective: Land astronauts on the Moon, perform surface exploration and return the crew safely to Earth.

name: Apollo 15
objective: Allow astronauts to explore a wider area, transport scientific tools and samples, and extend the range of lunar surface traverses.

name: Interior Exploration using Seismic Investigations, Geodesy and Heat Transport (InSight)
agency: NASA / United States, with international partners
objective: Measure Mars's internal structure and activity using seismic, heat-flow and precision-tracking measurements.

name: Lunar Orbiter 1
objective: Photograph candidate Apollo and Surveyor landing sites and collect lunar environmental measurements.

name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
objective: Map the lunar surface and measure temperature, composition, radiation and illumination conditions to support science and future exploration.

name: MRO
objective: Map surface, search for evidence of water and support communications

name: Mars 2020
objective: Search for signs of ancient microbial life and collect samples for possible return

name: Mars 2020 / Perseverance mission technology demonstration
objective: Demonstrate that powered, controlled flight is possible in Mars's thin atmosphere, then support rover route scouting and operations demonstrations.

name: Mars Atmosphere and Volatile Evolution
objective: Investigate how Mars lost much of its atmosphere

name: Mars Exploration Rover (MER-A)
objective: Study Martian rocks and soils for evidence of past water and assess the geological history of Gusev Crater.

name: Mars Exploration Rover (MER-B)
objective: Explore Martian rocks and soils for geological evidence of past water and assess whether ancient environments may have been habitable.

name: Mars Pathfinder
objective: Demonstrate low-cost landing technology and deploy Sojourner

name: Mars Science Laboratory
objective: Assess whether Mars ever had environments capable of supporting microbial life

name: Phoenix Mars Mission
agency: NASA / United States, with international partners
objective: Study the history of water and habitability in the Martian arctic by sampling soil and subsurface ice.

name: Surveyor 1
objective: Demonstrate a soft lunar landing and return surface images and basic information about the lunar surface.

name: Viking 1
objective: Image surface and analyze soil and atmosphere, including biology experiments

name: Viking 2
objective: Study Martian surface, atmosphere and soil
